purpose: Start exactly one traceable rerun from a verified clean entry with an already loaded corrected script.
trigger: Use after caller restored clean entry and loaded corrected artifact.

inputs.name: clean_entry_state
inputs.description: Observed clean design/baseline-copy entry, session identity, and no-dialog state.

inputs.name: loaded_corrected_script
inputs.description: Corrected script path/hash already loaded in matching session/document.

inputs.name: prior_failure_reference
inputs.description: Earlier failure identity and repair reference for correlation.

preconditions: Clean entry, loaded corrected script, authorization, and prior failure reference match.
No current run is already in progress.

outputs.name: rerun_event
outputs.description: One rerun ID, launch time, corrected hash, clean-entry identity, and prior-failure link.

outputs.name: launch_status
outputs.description: One of launched, rejected, or needs_manual_review; no terminal result.

postconditions: Exactly one rerun event is launched and linked to prior failure.
No cleanup, document creation, loading, waiting, or repair is included.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. One launch event only; terminal observation remains EX-10.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Entry is not proven clean or loaded script is not bound.
New launch cannot be correlated to prior failure.
failure_modes.detection: Run ID is missing/duplicated or response ambiguous.

recovery.action: Restore one missing state and recheck all gates.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Exactly one rerun event is launched and linked to prior failure.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
